Guidelines for assisting crewmembers in the exit
operation
Customers seated at a desianated exit row should
become familiar with the exit operation in order to
assist crewmembers.
The following guidelines review exit operations and
procedures:
Locate and identify the exit (refer to
pages 2& 3).
Type of exit (window/door).
Exit operation (including stowage).
Check to see that the exit is clear/sate to
use with no fire, obstruction, high water
level present.
Follow the verbal/hand directions of a
crewmember.
